description: Invent a new recipe for a specific dish the user named. Opens a private draft in their app (write; blocked on read-only accounts). Ask at most ONE short question, then write it with update_recipe and file it with finalize_recipe. Vague idea? Use suggest_dishes first; have the text already? Use save_recipe. Returns the draft {id, title, servings, assumed, optional_question, next}.

cuisine.description: Cuisine if known, e.g. "Thai"; inferred from the dish otherwise

diet.description: Diet labels only as the user stated them, e.g. ["Vegetarian"]

dish_chosen_by_user.description: The specific dish in the user's words, e.g. "chicken tikka masala" (not a category like "Indian")

flavor_direction.description: Flavor twist, max 200 chars, e.g. "smoky", "extra spicy", "classic"

name: start_recipe_draft
title: Create a new recipe
